detail.title: About Japanese Pokémon cards
detail.body1: Japanese Pokémon cards are produced by The Pokémon Company and often release sets, promos, and special rarities (such as SAR, SSR, and Character Rare cards) that differ from the English-language line. Sets like Pokémon 151, Shiny Treasure ex, and Eevee Heroes, along with chase cards like Charizard, Iono (Nanjamo) SAR, and Pikachu promos, are widely traded on Japanese marketplaces.
detail.body2: Buyers value Japanese cards for their print quality, exclusive artwork, and source pricing before overseas markups. Because grading and authenticity matter, we recommend reading the seller's condition notes and requesting photo inspection for any high-value or sealed item. Kangaroo Japan is an independent proxy buying service and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by The Pokémon Company.

customs.title: U.S. customs & taxes
customs.body: Importing trading cards into the United States is not automatically duty-free. We provide HS code guidance for trading cards, but U.S. customs duties and taxes are ultimately determined by U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) and the carrier. Any duties, taxes, or brokerage fees are the buyer's responsibility and are not included in our estimates.
